core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Consumer Health; Medical Devices; Vaccines; Digital Solutions
specialty_focus: Zuellig Pharma is a healthcare services provider and distributor across Asia, specializing in pharmaceutical distribution, cold chain logistics, and commercialization services. It focuses on therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, and rare diseases, and offers digital solutions for supply chain efficiency. While it distributes medical devices, its primary role is as a broadline distributor of healthcare products, not a wearable-device specialist.
